lang.title: Choose your language
lang.hint: You can change the language later in your profile.
welcome.title: Your training. Your plan.
welcome.text: Answer a few questions (about 7 minutes). Then you get your training and nutrition plan.
welcome.disclaimer: This app gives general training and nutrition advice. It does not replace medical advice. You train at your own risk.
empty.today.title: Your session will appear here
empty.today.text: Your profile is saved. The plan is built in the next step.
empty.plan.title: Your plan will appear here
empty.plan.text: All weeks and sessions will be listed here.
empty.progress.title: No data yet
empty.progress.text: As soon as you log your first workout or weight, you will see your progress here.
profile.title: Profile
profile.disclaimer: This does not replace medical advice.
q.invalid: Please enter a value between {min} and {max}.
q.geschlecht: Which sex should be used for the calculation?
h.geschlecht: Only for the calorie formula. For diverse or no answer, an average is used.
q.gewicht_kg: What do you weigh right now?
q.zielgewicht_kg: Do you have a goal weight?
h.zielgewicht_kg: Optional. The app never sets a value below BMI 18.5.
q.bb_phase: Which bodybuilding phase are you in?
h.bb_phase: Contest prep is only safe with a coach and a doctor. This app does not plan it.
q.hyrox_division: Which Hyrox division do you start in?
q.lauf_level: How long can you run easily without stopping?
q.kraft_erfahrung: How long have you trained strength regularly?
q.trainingstage: How many days per week do you want to train?
q.dauer_min: How much time do you have per session?
q.schritte: How active are you in daily life?
q.schlaf: How much do you sleep on average?
q.s1: Has a doctor told you that you have a heart condition or should only exercise under medical supervision?
q.s2: Do you have chest pain or pressure during exercise or in daily life?
q.s3: Do you sometimes feel dizzy or lose consciousness?
q.s4: Do you have a bone, joint or soft-tissue problem that could get worse with exercise?
q.s5: Do you take medication for your heart or blood pressure?
q.s6: Are you pregnant, or did you give birth in the last 6 months?
q.s7: Is there any other reason why you should not exercise?
q.verletzungen: Any complaints we should take into account? (multiple)
q.essstoerung: Have you ever had problems with eating behavior (for example an eating disorder)?
h.essstoerung: If yes or no answer, the app shows no calorie numbers.
q.kochzeit: How much time do you have to cook per meal?
q.mahlzeiten: How many meals per day suit you?
res.title: Your profile is ready
res.sub: This is what the app understood.
res.flag.yellow: Please ask your doctor before you start heavy training.
res.flag.nutri: Calorie numbers are switched off for you. You still get meal ideas.
res.red.title: Please check this with a doctor first
res.red.text: Based on your answers, a doctor should clear you before you train. Your answers are saved. Then we continue.
today.deload: Deload week: fewer sets, same or lighter weight.
today.hint: Pick a weight where you could still do about 3 more reps.
today.done.title: Workout done
today.nosets: Tick at least one set to finish.
today.blockdone: You completed your plan. Keep training or start again from your profile.
today.superset: Short on time: pair this with the next exercise (superset).
note.cap_days: You chose more days than is sensible for your level. Your plan uses {n} days.
note.endurance: Triathlon and Hyrox sessions are coming in the next update. The plan does not cover that part yet.
q.ziele: What are your goals? (you can choose several)
h.ziele: Tip: pick what matters to you now. Endurance goals and muscle gain together slow each other down.
q.prioritaet: Which goal matters most right now?
o.ort.studio_hyrox: Gym with Hyrox equipment (sled, SkiErg, rower, wall balls)
q.heim: What do you have at home? (multiple)
q.mag: What do you like to eat? (multiple)
h.mag: The more you pick, the more variety you get. If you like everything, choose that.
note.recomp: Building muscle and losing fat at the same time works best slowly. Expect small steps, especially if you are new to training.
note.endu_conflict: Muscle gain and endurance goals compete for recovery. Your plan puts your top priority first.
note.event_soon: Your race is closer than a full plan needs. The plan is shortened, so aim to finish well, not for a personal best.
info.title: How to do it
info.de_only: These tips are in German for now. The English version follows.
coach.goals.title: Your goals
coach.goals.text: Your plan adapts automatically to your results. Only change your goals here if they really change.
coach.qa.hint: Tap an exercise to see how it is done.
nutri.note.min: Your target is set to the safe minimum. A bigger deficit is not sensible without guidance.
nutri.note.cut: Expected change: about {kg} kg per week. Faster is not better.
nutri.note.muscle: A small surplus supports muscle gain. Gain slowly and steadily.
nutri.off: Calorie numbers are switched off for you. You still get meal ideas, new every week.
nutri.weeknote: New suggestions every Monday. A single day does not need to be exact: the weekly average counts.
nutri.proteinhint: Tip: add quark, skyr or a protein shake to reach your protein target today.
nutri.shop.title: Shopping list for this week
nutri.shop.hint: A suggestion for this week, matched to your goals, including pre-workout meals. Swap a dish and the list updates.
nutri.disc: These are estimates, not medical advice.
weight.perweek: {kg} kg per week ({pct} % of body weight)
weight.wait: Log your weight about 3 times over 2 weeks. Then your trend appears here.
weight.invalid: Enter a weight between 30 and 300 kg.
weight.adj: Your calorie target was adjusted by {n} kcal based on your trend.
weight.adv.cut.tooslow: Slower than planned. The app lowers your calorie target by 100 kcal (at most every 2 weeks).
weight.adv.cut.toofast: Faster than recommended. The app raises your calorie target by 100 kcal to protect muscle.
weight.adv.muscle.tooslow: Slower than planned. The app raises your calorie target by 100 kcal.
weight.adv.muscle.toofast: Faster than planned, more of it may be fat. The app lowers your calorie target by 100 kcal.
weight.adv.hold.tooslow: Your weight is dropping. The app raises your calorie target by 100 kcal.
weight.adv.hold.toofast: Your weight is rising. The app lowers your calorie target by 100 kcal.
rs.predictnote: Estimates from one result. Real race pace depends on training, weather and course.
race.name: Name
race.none: No races yet. Add your next event.
race.invalid: Enter a name and a date.
share.title: Share your workout
share.hint: Pick a style. On your phone, “Share” opens your apps. Your photo stays on your device.
share.saved: Image saved. Find it in your downloads or photos and pick it in Instagram or WhatsApp.
run.title: Run
run.cont: {m} min easy running without a break
run.q.strides: Easy, then 4–6 strides (15–20 s relaxed fast)
run.q.strides_n: Easy, then {n} strides (15–20 s relaxed fast)
run.q.fast: Including {n} × {m} min fast, {r} min jog between
run.q.tempo: Including {m} min tempo (comfortably hard), 8–10 min easy before and after
run.q.km_tempo: Including {n} × 1 km at tempo, jog between
run.q.km_fast: Including {n} × 1 km brisk, {r} min easy jog between
run.q.km_mrt: Including {n} × 1 km at marathon pace, short
run.q.mrt_from: From km {at}: {km} km at marathon pace
run.how.easy: Conversation pace: you can speak in full sentences.
run.how.quality: Run the fast parts by feel, the rest easy. Too hard? Vary your speed as it feels good.
run.how.race: Start calmly. Finishing is the goal.
run.how.runwalk: Conversation pace. Out of breath? Walk. Walking breaks are part of training. Too hard? Repeat the week.
run.how.cont: Very easy. Out of breath? Walk for a moment.
run.warm: Walk briskly for 5 min before, cool down easy for 5 min after.
run.stop: Chest pain, dizziness or breathlessness that does not ease quickly: stop at once; for chest pain call emergency services (112 in the EU). Pain (not just effort): rest.
run.pace.none: Add a run time under Progress → Results to see your pace guide.
run.log.title: Log your session
run.log.hint: Duration is required, distance is optional.
run.log.invalid: Please enter a duration from 1 to 1200 minutes (distance up to 400 km).
note.run: Strength and running are mixed each week. Keep at least 1 rest day. No heavy leg session right before a speed or long run. Short on days? Drop an easy run first.
run.brick: {bike} min bike, then straight into a {run} min run
run.how.hybrid: Run 1 km, then one station, and repeat. Steady, never to failure.
run.how.sim: Practise like race day, including transitions. Split it with a break if needed.
run.how.hyroxrace: Do not start faster than planned. Nothing new on race day.
run.how.swim: Technique before speed. Resting at the wall is fine.
run.how.bike: Easy: you can speak in full sentences.
run.how.bikehard: Warm up easy, do the hard parts, cool down easy.
run.how.brick: Keep the run off the bike short and controlled. Practise eating and drinking.
run.how.trirace: Start calmly. Finishing is the goal.
run.q.sim_full: Full race distance in parts: 8 × (1 km + station)
run.q.hx_weight: Stations in sets, at race weight if you can
run.q.hx_interval: Intervals: 4–6 × 3–5 min fast, 2–3 min jog between
run.q.hx_tempo: Tempo: 10–25 min comfortably hard, 8–10 min easy before and after
run.q.swim_css: Technique plus sets at threshold pace (CSS)
run.q.swim_200: Technique plus 5 × 200 m at threshold pace (CSS)
run.q.bike_threshold: Including 2 × 15 min at threshold (hard but even)
run.q.bike_sweet: Including blocks just below threshold (sweet spot)
run.q.bike_race3: Bike with 3 × 15 min at race pace
run.safe.swim: Never swim in open water alone. In an emergency call 112.
run.safe.bike: Always wear a helmet and follow traffic rules.
note.tri: Triathlon: keep at least 1 full rest day and do not put hard days back to back. Volumes outside the build phase are derived estimates. A sprint requires: swim 400 m, bike 20 km, run 5 km. Get a medical check first.
note.hyrox: Hyrox: weights and reps are not officially verified yet (Open women wall balls may be 75). Please check hyrox.com.
note.one_endurance: You have several endurance goals. The plan trains only one at a time to avoid overload: your most important one.
priv.title: Privacy
priv.local: Your answers, workouts, weights and results are stored only in this browser on your device. There is no account, no server of our own, no ads and no tracking.
priv.photo: Photos for share cards stay on your device. They only leave it when you tap Share and pick an app.
priv.fonts: Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts. In doing so, Google technically receives your IP address.
priv.host: The app is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub may log technical data such as your IP address when you open it.
priv.links: Video links take you to YouTube, where YouTube's rules apply.
priv.delete: To erase everything, delete this site's data in your browser settings. Your entries are then gone.
share.week.title: My week
share.weight.title: My progress
share.empty.title: Sharing
share.empty.text: Finish your first session in the “Today” tab. Then you can share it here as an image: Instagram, WhatsApp or save it.
nutri.traintap: Tap to change. Training days include a pre-workout meal.
nutri.during: Session over 60 minutes: 30–60 g carbs per hour during it (practise in training).
feel.title: How was the session?
feel.thanks: Noted. Your coach takes this into account.
feel.paintext: Your plan gets easier. Rest if it hurts and have ongoing pain checked by a doctor. Chest pain: call 112 / emergency services.
cardio.title: Extra cardio this week
cardio.text: {n} × 30 min easy (brisk walk or bike, you can still talk). Also aim for 7,000–10,000 steps a day.
note.light: Because of your health answers the plan is deliberately light: no intervals or race pace. Keep about 4 reps in reserve. Talk to your doctor before you start.
check.intro: Your coach reads your feedback, times and weight and adjusts the plan by fixed rules. Everything stays on your device.
check.adh.ok: Last 14 days: {done} of {total} sessions. Strong, keep going.
check.adh.low: Last 14 days: {done} of {total} sessions. Better less but regular: set fewer training days in your profile, or do 10 minutes on tough days. It counts.
check.plateau.1: Do you weigh often enough? Go by the weekly average, not single days.
check.plateau.2: Are portions accurate, including weekends, drinks, snacks and oil?
check.plateau.3: Are you moving less in daily life than usual?
check.none: No adjustments yet. Rate each session afterwards and log your weight.
check.c.gym_down: Strength sessions were too hard more than once: 1 set fewer per exercise.
check.c.gym_pain: You reported pain: 1 set fewer per exercise.
check.c.gym_up: Too easy three times: 1 more set per exercise.
check.c.endu_down: Endurance was too hard more than once: 10% less volume.
check.c.endu_pain: You reported pain: 10% less endurance volume.
check.c.endu_up: Too easy three times: 5% more endurance volume.
check.c.hx_up: Your Hyrox time is {pct}% faster: 1 more station per session.
check.c.hx_down: The Hyrox session was {pct}% slower and too hard: 1 station fewer.
check.c.cardio_up: Your weight is barely moving: added 1 × 30 min cardio, calories stay the same.
check.c.cardio_down: You are losing very fast: 1 cardio session fewer.
check.c.kcal_down: Your weight is not moving as planned: {n} kcal less per day (never below the minimum).
check.c.kcal_up: Your weight trend calls for more energy: {n} kcal more per day.
